name: Reviewed content publishing
outcome: A sourced article passes independent audience review and remains human-approved before publication.

verifier.green_means: The published artifact matches the approved, sourced draft and records its public URL.

stop.success: The release checker accepts the publication evidence after explicit H1 approval.

nodes.name: Source the claims
nodes.outcome: Material claims are source-linked and separated from opinion or inference.

contract.goal: Build a claim sheet that distinguishes sourced fact, inference, and opinion.

verifier.green_means: Every material factual claim has a usable source and unsupported claims are removed or relabeled.

stop.success: The claim auditor accepts the claim sheet.

nodes.name: Draft the article
nodes.outcome: A useful draft communicates one clear thesis without overstating product proof.

contract.goal: Write a practical article from the accepted claim sheet and positioning brief.

verifier.green_means: The draft is useful, coherent, claim-safe, and aligned with the positioning brief.

stop.success: The positioning editor accepts the draft.

nodes.name: Run bounded audience review
nodes.outcome: A bounded reader panel identifies comprehension, credibility, and usefulness risks.

contract.goal: Challenge the draft across named reader perspectives and resolve material findings.

verifier.green_means: Material panel findings are addressed or explicitly rejected with rationale, without treating simulation as customer proof.

stop.success: The editorial critic accepts the final review packet.

nodes.name: Approve public publication
nodes.outcome: A named human explicitly approves the exact final artifact for public release.
evidence: timestamped approval bound to the final artifact digest

nodes.name: Publish the approved artifact
nodes.outcome: The exact approved artifact is published once and its public URL is recorded.

contract.goal: Publish the approved artifact once and capture the resulting public surface.

verifier.green_means: The public artifact matches the approved digest, appears once, and has a recorded URL.

stop.success: The release checker accepts the public artifact and URL.
